_comment: Models shown by /ar.html. Each entry: id (URL ?m=), glb (required, metres, Y-up), usdz (optional - iOS Quick Look uses it directly, otherwise model-viewer converts the GLB on the fly), placement floor|wall, scale fixed (life-size) | auto. See the repo README for the scan-to-web pipeline.

caption.zh: 示範模型：一座 2.4 公尺高的石灰岩基座與大理石半身像。真正的景點掃描完成後，只要把掃描檔放進 scans/，GitHub Actions 會自動轉檔並登記，就會在這裡出現。
caption.en: Demo model: a 2.4 m limestone pedestal with a marble bust. Once a real landmark is scanned, drop the scan into scans/ and register it in index.json and it appears here.

models.credit: Procedural demo built in Blender 4.5 - stand-in for an iPhone Object Capture scan
